usb.note: 4.35/5.25 V are design stress points for this budget. RGB SDB defaults low, but complete-board power-up current remains unmeasured.

input_current_limit.fault: open-drain active-low to GP29 with 10 kOhm pull-up to 3V3

rgb_boost.enable: tied to SYS_5V; boost rail remains powered while USB power switch is on
rgb_boost.output_caps: 2 x 22 uF X5R/X7R; verify combined effective capacitance >=10 uF at RGB_5V1 bias

rgb_driver.led_topology: common anode pin 3 sourced by SWx; red/green/blue cathodes pins 1/2/4 sink through CS lines
rgb_driver.conservative_method: Lumissil formula with GCC=SL=255, multiplied by datasheet 41.04/38 max/typ current factor and 1% low RSET.
rgb_driver.headroom_screen_method: For a bounded design screen only, derive equivalent maximum resistances from Lumissil VHR maximum test points and scale them to E02 conservative sink current and aggregate SW current. The datasheet does not guarantee linear VHR scaling at these lower currents; routed-board voltage/ripple and physical LED Vf still require measurement.
rgb_driver.sdb_default: 100 kOhm pulldown; GP28 must drive high only after firmware permits RGB

logic_budget.meaning: Design allocation for the complete 3V3 load at the SYS_5V input side; not a measured or guaranteed maximum.

worst_case_input_budget.method: Iterate TPS2553 85 mOhm drop at 4.35 V receptacle stress point; boost uses maximum calculated RGB_5V1, 85% efficiency assumption, 39-channel RGB current plus 20 mA driver allocation; add 80 mA logic allocation.

release_blockers: Measure complete-board pre-enumeration current on VBUS.
Measure RGB_5V1 regulation/ripple at minimum and maximum VBUS, all-white load and temperature extremes.
Confirm TPS2553-1 trip/latch behavior and recovery on a physical board.
Confirm TPS61023 efficiency, inductor current and output-capacitor effective capacitance on the routed PCB.
Measure actual Everlight 19-237A/BHR6GHC-A01/2T Vf and RGB path headroom on the routed board; the E02 current-scaled VHR calculation is a screening assumption, not a guaranteed datasheet condition.
Perform thermal checks on TLV75533P, TPS2553-1, TPS61023, RGB driver and PCB traces at worst intended load.
